en.headline: Employers’ hiring outlook rebounds to +14pc for fourth quarter
en.dek: ManpowerGroup’s latest survey of 603 Hong Kong employers shows net employment sentiment swung from minus 9 per cent last quarter to plus 14 per cent, with information technology the strongest sector.
body: Hong Kong employers’ hiring intentions strengthened markedly for the fourth quarter, according to ManpowerGroup’s latest Employment Outlook Survey released on Tuesday. The seasonally adjusted net employment outlook rose to plus 14 per cent, a 23-percentage-point improvement from minus 9 per cent in the previous quarter.

Of the 603 employers surveyed, 30 per cent planned to increase headcount in the coming three months, 16 per cent expected to reduce staff and 54 per cent foresaw no change. The information technology sector recorded the highest outlook at plus 27 per cent, followed by finance and insurance at plus 21 per cent. Health and social services was the only sector still in negative territory, at minus 3 per cent.

ManpowerGroup Greater China senior vice-president Tsui Yuk-shan attributed the rebound to solid first-half GDP growth of 5.1 per cent, the government’s raised full-year growth forecast and resilient domestic demand. She noted that government support for artificial intelligence and digital transformation was boosting demand for IT talent, while active IPO and wealth-management activity continued to support financial hiring.

zh.headline: 第四季就業展望指數回升至正14% 資訊業最樂觀
zh.dek: 萬寶盛華調查603名僱主，季節性調整後就業展望指數由上季負9%升至正14%，三成計劃增聘，資訊科技業指數最高達27%。
body: 人力資源顧問公司萬寶盛華（ManpowerGroup）香港今日公布2026年第四季就業展望調查，經季節性調整後的就業展望指數為正14%，較上一季的負9%上升23個百分點，顯示僱主招聘意欲轉趨正面。
在603名受訪僱主中，30%預計未來三個月會增加人手，16%預期縮減，54%表示不會調整。八個行業中，資訊科技業招聘意欲最強，指數達正27%；其次是金融與保險業正21%。唯一錄得負值的是醫療及社會服務業，為負3%。
萬寶盛華大中華高級副總裁徐玉珊表示，本港上半年實質GDP按年增長5.1%，屬近五年最強半年度表現，政府亦上調全年經濟增長預測，失業率維持3.7%，為企業擴張及增聘提供有利環境。她指政府加強對人工智能及數碼轉型的支持，帶動資訊產業人才需求，而IPO及財富管理業務活躍則支持金融業招聘。
